textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 maths · Time Goes On · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: A week has seven days. They are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday, and then the week starts again. A year has twelve months.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A week has seven days. They are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday, and then the week starts again. A year has twelve months.
beats.speakEn: A week has seven days. They are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday, and then the week starts again. A year has twelve months.

beats.en: An ordinary year has 365 days, or 52 full weeks and 1 extra day. A leap year has 366 days, or 52 full weeks and 2 extra days. Some months have 31 days, some have 30 and February has fewer than 30.
beats.speakEn: An ordinary year has 365 days, or 52 full weeks and 1 extra day. A leap year has 366 days, or 52 full weeks and 2 extra days. Some months have 31 days, some have 30 and February has fewer than 30.

textbookBox.concept: A birth certificate tells us a person's name, date and place of birth and the names of the parents. Bincy's certificate says she was born on 02/05/2015. That is the second of May in the year 2015.

beats.en: A clock has a short hour hand and a long minute hand. The hour hand tells the hour and the minute hand tells the minutes. When the minute hand points to 12 it is an o'clock time such as 7 o'clock.
